entry.author: Taupo District Council
entry.summary:
If you own a dog, make sure its registration is up to date before 1 July each year.

There are several easy ways to pay your registration:

- Online by credit card
- Internet banking (using the details on your notice)
- In person at our customer service centres

Once you’ve paid, you’ll receive a new registration tag in the post within 10 working days. Dogs must wear their current tag when out in public - it helps identify them if they get lost. A new tag is issued each year, with a different colour for easy recognition. This year it's a fresh minty-green colour!

Your registration fee supports important services like animal control, dog parks, and responding to lost or roaming dogs.

If your dog is new or hasn’t been registered before, please make sure you register them as soon as possible.

For more information about registration go to www.taupo.govt.nz/dogs or call the team on 07 376 0899.
